name: 194. Custom tools on models older than GPT-5 (custom-tools-as-functions)
description: OpenAI custom (freeform) tools shipped with GPT-5. Older models such as gpt-4o reject them with 400 "Invalid value: 'custom'" on tools. Bifrost now sends each custom tool to those models as a function tool with one string `input` parameter (only when its datasheet row sets supports_custom_tools to false; with no flag custom tools pass through) and turns the model's function call back into a custom_tool_call, so the client sees the same shape it gets from GPT-5. 194.1 pins the non-streaming Responses route, 194.2 the streaming one, where the held-back argument deltas come out as one custom_tool_call_input delta and done. 194.3 pins the Codex shape: exec nested in the functions namespace of an additional_tools input item, plus include reasoning.encrypted_content, which a non-reasoning model rejects.
